# Folder Boundary Model

Folders are organizational objects inside one knowledge base.
They help import tree display and browsing, but they do not create a separate authorization boundary.
Query scope and access control still stay at the knowledge-base level.
中文补充：文件夹只是知识库内部的组织对象，不应被当成新的授权边界。
中文补充：查询范围和访问控制仍然以知识库为边界。
